metadata.source_note: Minimal contract for a local-only CREATURE_ATTACKS -> DEAL_DAMAGE bridge with strict explicit wording and no combat-engine expansion.

bridge_kind.label: creature_attacks -> deal_damage
bridge_kind.purpose: Enable strict local closure where an explicit this-creature-attacks trigger co-exists with local deal-damage payoff wording.

activation_scope.description: Bridge applies only within the same local card/profile.

activation_predicate.text_evidence_policy: Require explicit wording equivalent to 'Whenever this creature attacks, it deals N damage ...'.
honesty_constraints: Reject damage text without explicit this-creature-attacks trigger.
Reject 'one or more creatures attack' wording.

no_goals: No 'deals combat damage to a player' modeling
